summary: Phase 2B.9 Translation Quality Acceleration Blueprint for GolpoTranslate: comprehensive evidence-based assessment of the current 5-stage translation pipeline, concrete defect analysis from The Owing Book (V1/V2), The Quiet Key (V1), and The Clockmaker of Old Calcutta, root-cause analysis, 7-dimension non-compensatory evaluation framework, benchmark suite, prioritized high-ROI improvements, implementation roadmap, and exact specification for the first implementation milestone (2B.9a).
